headline: Jimmy Fallon Pokes Fun at Trump’s ‘Pinky Herman’
context: “You got to give Trump credit: He misspeaks in ways nobody ever thought possible,” Fallon said of the president’s calling the famous man-child character “Pinky,” instead of “Pee-wee,” Herman.
